page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple standard tests. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1434.29, while the multi-core score reaches 7647.48. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 427.07 GB/sec and a write speed of 37.03 GB/sec for large blocks. In application-specific benchmarks, the server achieves a static web serving throughput of 6.99 GB/sec and handles 7.45 million operations per second in Redis SET tests.

The instance exhibits clear performance limitations in resource-intensive tasks. While it processes prompts at 515.08 tokens per second for a small 135M LLM model, its performance drops to a poor rating of 11.53 tokens per second for a medium 7B model, indicating it is not suited for larger language model inference. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
